|game_text=May add 1 pilot (suspends permanent pilot). May move as a 'react.' Permanent pilot provides ability of 2 and adds 2 to power. Dual Laser Cannon may deploy aboard. When deployed, may ▼ [[Dual Laser Cannon (V){{!}}Dual Laser Cannon]] aboard.
|errata_history=This is version PC-E4 of [[AT-RT]]. The first printing is lost, so it has no page. Other versions: [[AT-RT (Errata)]] (PC-E1), [[AT-RT (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2), [[AT-RT (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3), [[AT-RT (Errata 5)]] (PC-E5, the current text). No published image prints this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB9-03-AT_RT-PC-E4-cardmaker.png]], made 11 November 2026). How these versions came about (Holotable data, the PC website card list, the Master List and the PC card images) is told in [[PC Legacy Virtual Transcription Error History]].
* '''Original''' (first printing; no copy survives, so no page): the first Virtual Block 9.1 text (released 10 January 2014). No copy of it survives: on 22 January 2014 the rules team wrote that “shortly after the release” the AT-RT text had been modified so that it works with Dual Laser Cannon as intended, and that the current PDF has the correct text<ref name="forum-p862180">Players Committee forum, thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=36574, now titled “Current Rulings Archive August 2012 - December 2015”), post by Lukes Bionic Hand, 22 January 2014: [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=36574&start=40#p862180 p862180] (read 9–11 November 2026)</ref>. Its words are not known for certain; the Players Committee card image (PC-E3) may print them.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[AT-RT (Errata)]]): the Virtual Block 9.1 release sheet as it survives (still headed “official text as of 10 January 2014”)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock9_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock9_1.pdf#page=13 Virtual Block 9.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 10 January 2014"), page 13, slip 71 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/None/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock9_1.pdf#page=13 Internet Archive]</ref>, with the text the rules team posted on 22 January 2014<ref name="forum-p862180">Players Committee forum, thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=36574, now titled “Current Rulings Archive August 2012 - December 2015”), post by Lukes Bionic Hand, 22 January 2014: [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=36574&start=40#p862180 p862180] (read 9–11 November 2026)</ref>: power 3; “May add 1 pilot (suspends permanent pilot). May move as a 'react.' Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. "T-47" on [Hoth] weapons may be treated as "AT-RT". When deployed, may ▼ Dual Laser Cannon aboard.” '''What changed''' (from the Players Committee card image wording, PC-E3, which may be the first text): “Dual Laser Cannnon may deploy aboard.” is “"T-47" on [Hoth] weapons may be treated as "AT-RT".”
* '''PC-E2''' ([[AT-RT (Errata 2)]]): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (cover “official text as of 27 April 2013”, but it already prints Virtual Block 9 (released 10 January 2014); PDF built 3 February 2014; Light Side, p. 52)<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=52, page 52. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=52 Internet Archive]</ref>: “May add 1 pilot (suspends permanent pilot). May move as a 'react.' Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. "T-47" on [Hoth] weapons may be treated as "AT-RT". When deployed, may ▼ Dual Laser Cannon aboard.” '''What changed:''' nothing: word for word the PC-E1 text. A repeat of an earlier text is a version of its own (wiki versions rulings, 11 November 2026).
* '''PC-E3''' ([[AT-RT (Errata 3)]]): the Players Committee card image, dated 18 February 2014 on the PC image server<ref name="srv-Virtual9-Light">Players Committee card image server, directory listing of <code>cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual9-Light/large/</code>, every card image dated 18 February 2014: [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034938/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual9-Light/large/?C=M;O=A Internet Archive capture of 18 August 2019]. The files are byte for byte the ones still served today (research R6, 10–11 November 2026).</ref>: “May add 1 pilot (suspends permanent pilot). May move as a 'react.' Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. Dual Laser Cannnon may deploy aboard. When deployed, may ▼ Dual Laser Cannon aboard.”; power 3 The server date is the date of a bulk upload of the whole folder: the image may have been made earlier, but it is placed at the date it can be shown to exist (Bill, 11 November 2026). '''What changed:''' “"T-47" on [Hoth] weapons may be treated as "AT-RT".” is gone and “Dual Laser Cannnon may deploy aboard.” (sic) is in its place. This may be the wording of the lost first printing, which the rules team corrected by 22 January 2014.
* '''PC-E4''' (this page): Competitive Balance Team errata posted on the Players Committee forum on 23 July 2014, effective immediately<ref name="forum-p894811">Players Committee forum, thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=36574, now titled “Current Rulings Archive August 2012 - December 2015”), post by darkjediknight11, 23 July 2014: [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=36574&start=40#p894811 p894811] (read 9–11 November 2026)</ref>: power 1; “May add 1 pilot (suspends permanent pilot). May move as a 'react.' Permanent pilot provides ability of 2 and adds 2 to power. Dual Laser Cannon may deploy aboard. When deployed, may ▼ Dual Laser Cannon aboard.” '''What changed:''' power 3 became power 1; the permanent pilot also “adds 2 to power”; the “T-47” sentence was replaced by “Dual Laser Cannon may deploy aboard.” Two days later the team wrote that there had been “an error in carrying over some text” and posted PC-E3.
* '''PC-E5''' ([[AT-RT (Errata 5)]]): the corrected errata posted on the Players Committee forum on 25 July 2014<ref name="forum-p895797">Players Committee forum, thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=36574, now titled “Current Rulings Archive August 2012 - December 2015”), post by darkjediknight11, 25 July 2014: [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=36574&start=40#p895797 p895797] (read 9–11 November 2026)</ref>: power 1; “May add 1 pilot (suspends permanent pilot). May move as a 'react.' Permanent pilot provides ability of 2 and adds 2 to power. "T-47" on [Hoth] weapons may be treated as "AT-RT".” '''What changed:''' the “T-47” sentence is back and “Dual Laser Cannon may deploy aboard.” and the deploy-time Dual Laser Cannon download are gone (the posted text has no Dual Laser Cannon sentence, although the post says the Dual Laser Cannon's function “should not have changed”).
